# Validation image credits

These photographs are test fixtures, not training data or a representative accuracy benchmark.

- `amanita.jpg`: [Amanita muscaria (fruiting body)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Amanita_muscaria_(fruiting_body).jpg), copyright Hans Hillewaert, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Original JPEG, unchanged.
- `boletus.jpg`: [Boletus edulis R.H. (12)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boletus_edulis_R.H._(12).jpg), Rob Hille, [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Original JPEG, unchanged.
- Corresponding PNG/WebP fixtures are resized/re-encoded versions made for numerical tests; same respective licenses and attribution apply.

No identification or edibility accuracy is established by these fixtures. They only compare implementations of the existing model.
